actual_scope: Enable the complete fixed PR5466 checklist under optimized CPython through a hash-bound assertion-preserving source adapter.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one reproducible environment failure repair. The frozen bounded-kernel entry rejects -O because its certificate checks use assertions. This opt-in adapter changes that execution boundary while retaining the checklist; no mathematical audit or arithmetic/storage extension is the deliverable.
bottleneck_link: Verifier portability side result. It preserves a bounded arithmetic kernel checklist across interpreter optimization; it does not discharge a selected framework assumption or improve the signed supplier moment.
stop_rule: Stop at the first complete normal/optimized preservation pass and its fault controls. Do not extend the arithmetic, allocator, optimized modes or scientific domain.
evidence: PROOF.md, adapter.py and verify.py; complete original-versus-adapted result comparison, 55 assertion sites, 24 semantic comparisons and nine rejections.
